narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Ten and ten make twenty, so the total is twenty to the power nine.
<bookmark mark='big'/>Twenty to the power nine is five hundred twelve times ten to the power nine.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That is far more than two flocks of that size, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 10⁹ + 10⁹ = 20⁹; 20⁹ = 2⁹ × 10⁹ = 512 × 10⁹ is written; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, say each power as a number name, like crore.
<bookmark mark='size'/>Adding two equal amounts only doubles the number. It never changes the power of ten by much.
removed_beats.on_screen: the check line say each power as a number name appears; the check line adding two equal amounts doubles appears

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu adds the bases ten and ten and says twenty to the power nine. One hundred crore and one hundred crore make two hundred crore, so the bubble is struck.
